verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so ClickHouse clients and drivers connect unchanged. It also names BI and dashboard tools (Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau, DBeaver) that connect without custom glue. missing for 10: explicit mention of JDBC/ODBC drivers, per-tool setup guides for the named BI integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of BI connectivity.
